text: The Patriots welcome offensive lineman Matt Pryor to the 53-man roster after signing him from the Arizona Cardinals practice squad, a move that arrives as the offensive line infrastructure takes fresh damage with guard Greg Van Roten placed on injured reserve due to a thigh injury—all of this amid a deeper offensive crisis, as New England sits dead last in the NFL at 9.7 points per game and heads to Buffalo carrying a 1-2 record to face the undefeated 3-0 Bills in a crucial AFC East showdown at Highmark Stadium. Drake Maye said Wednesday that his right shoulder remains fine and presents no impediment to his throwing ability, pivoting instead to the need for better decision-making to reverse early-season struggles, while the Patriots' gameplan will attempt to counter a Josh Allen who has consistently demonstrated the ability to compartmentalize and move past sloppy performances. Off the field, Ann Maye, Drake's wife, volunteered at Family Food Connections on Tuesday and presented a $100,000 donation from the MayeDay Family Foundation to support the food pantry's work addressing food insecurity in the community.
